scheme_name: Financial Assistance to War Widows of Defence Forces
other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow of a Defence Force personnel (Army, Navy, or Air Force) who was killed in action during the declared wars of 1962, 1965, or 1971.
Applicant must be a bona fide resident of Haryana.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹3,000 per month financial assistance (with an annual increase of ₹400) to eligible war widows, in addition to the existing family pension.
